claim_boundary: Research documentation. NOT evidence for or against the Riemann Hypothesis in either direction. NO RH CLAIM.

families.WEIL_POSITIVITY_WINDOWS: Weil/Gabor quadratic form, compact-window certificates, λ*-ladder, narrowband, world controls of Q_W
families.SCREW_SUBORDINATION_LSTAR: L* lemma, screw positivity, two-measure subordination, augmented duality, terminal q, canonical certificate windows
families.LEAN_FORMALIZATION: Lean 4 modules (Gabor criterion iff RH, bridges, contracts, sorry census)
families.EXPLICIT_FORMULA_IDENTITY: trace-formula identities, arch/digamma/heat/Mellin identities, coefficient telescopes (identity side only)
families.OPERATOR_SPECTRAL: Hilbert–Pólya-type operators, prolate/CCM, Connes observable, de Branges/canonical systems/Suzuki screw, Krein, dual resolvent, Borodin–Uvarov
families.RHP_IIKS_TAU: Riemann–Hilbert problems, IIKS, Toda/tau dictionaries, lattice parametrices, vanishing metric
families.TOEPLITZ_MOMENT_POSITIVITY: Toeplitz minors, Jensen/Turán, Hankel, Stieltjes/Pick/Bernstein moment tests
families.MELLIN_PICK_LEE_YANG: Mellin quotient, KPS/van Dantzig, Bernstein–Pick, Laguerre multiplier, Lee–Yang
families.LATTICE_E8_HECKE: E8 theta/E4, Hecke/Kneser, Jensen compilers, Coxeter, ordered-E8 Herglotz, E8 readouts
families.ADELIC_GROUPOID_CONNES: Gate 0, groupoids, KMS/Bost–Connes, UCP windows, half-density, tree boundary, scaling site
families.ARAKELOV_HODGE_INTERSECTION: Kasteleyn/orientation, Hodge chamber, cone dynamics, Quillen/BFK seam chain, K3/Kummer, del Pezzo
families.CM_CURVE_GEOMETRY: curve y^3=x^4−1, periods, polarization, Gauss–Manin transport
families.DYNAMICS_CLOCKS_PF: Perron–Frobenius, Markov/μ4 clocks, nodeless PF, Lindblad, tropical heat, cone dynamics
families.PRIME_EVENT_LOG_DECODING: relay lead/vote/lead law, event-log side channels
families.SIEVE_FACTORING_GEOMETRY: regulator jump, seam geodesic/SQUFOF, Hylaean fibre, clock torsion ECM (GEOM contracts; not RH)
families.CERTIFICATE_INFRASTRUCTURE: Arb evaluators, tail bounds, quadrature lemmas, AST firewalls, world-control harnesses
families.EXTERNAL_ADJUDICATION: audits of external papers/repos (Chuk, KPS, arXiv:2607.16795, Murru–Salvatori, OpenAI gaps)

kinds.ATTACK: a mechanism attempt aimed at an RH-adjacent statement
kinds.REDUCTION: reduces one statement to another without claiming the target
kinds.FOUNDATION: identity, lemma, or dictionary that later attacks sit on
kinds.CERTIFICATE: finite or exact certificate (numerical or symbolic)
kinds.CONTROL: world-control, twin, null, mutant, or firewall test
kinds.EXTERNAL_AUDIT: audit of an external paper or repository

outcomes.CERTIFIED: sealed numerical or exact certificate at a stated [E]/[C] level
outcomes.MEASURED: quantitative measurement with no certificate claim
outcomes.KILLED: mechanism refuted or recorded as a no-go
outcomes.OPEN: not yet executed, still open, or awaiting review
outcomes.RESTATED: restatement of a prior result, no new content
outcomes.SEALED: probe or round frozen (SPEC_SHA) without a new theorem

failure_classes.CIRCULAR: uses RH or a known equivalent as a hidden premise
failure_classes.WORLD_BLIND: does not separate the arithmetic world from controls
failure_classes.LOSSY_CONSTANT: a constant or inequality loses the needed margin
failure_classes.STRUCTURAL_MISMATCH: the objects compared are not the same object
failure_classes.NUMERIC_ARTIFACT: result is a precision or discretization artifact
failure_classes.ORACLE_LEAK: uses future, fitted, or oracle information
failure_classes.RESTATEMENT: restates a known result without a new bridge
failure_classes.NO_BRIDGE: no dictionary from the construction to an RH-adjacent statement
failure_classes.UNCONVERGED: computation or search did not converge
failure_classes.NOT_APPLICABLE: not a failure (success, open, sealed, or N/A)

rh_relevances.LOAD_BEARING_OPEN: open edge that would be load-bearing if closed
rh_relevances.EQUIVALENCE: equivalent to RH or a named RH equivalent
rh_relevances.IDENTITY_SIDE: identity or trace-formula side, not a positivity attack
rh_relevances.INFRASTRUCTURE: tooling, harness, docs, inventory, or catalog
rh_relevances.UNRELATED: not an RH mechanism (e.g. GEOM contracts)

confidence.low: stub, inferred, or not yet reviewed
confidence.med: read from artefact with residual ambiguity
confidence.high: verbatim from a sealed probe, ledger row, or Lean module
